name: Checkbox
description: A checkbox turns one option on or off, or lets people pick any number of options from a list. The choice applies when the form is submitted. CheckboxGroup puts several under one question with a single legend and error.
whenToUse: To pick any number of options, including none, from a short list.
For a single yes/no in a form, e.g. “I accept the terms”.
For a select-all box over a list (indeterminate when some are selected).

whenNotToUse.text: When exactly one option must be chosen.
For a setting that applies immediately.
For a long list of options.
whenNotToUse.alternative: Select or Combobox with multiple selection

anatomy.name: Box
anatomy.description: Ticked, empty or showing a dash (indeterminate).

anatomy.name: Error
anatomy.description: For a single checkbox; groups show one error for all.

values.meaning: 14px box, small label; dense lists and tables.
Options stacked. Default; easiest to scan.
Two or three short options in a row; wraps when narrow.

states.name: Checked
states.meaning: On: filled box with a tick.

states.name: Indeterminate
states.meaning: Some, not all: a dash; announced as “mixed”.

behavior.text: A real <input type="checkbox"> sits on top of the drawn box, so forms, autofill, Space to toggle and screen readers work as usual.
Inside CheckboxGroup, each Checkbox’s value is added to or removed from the group’s value array.
Set indeterminate when some items are checked; clicking it then checks all (your handler decides).

content: Labels: positive statements (“Email me updates”), not negatives (“Don’t email me”).
Group legend: the question (“Which topics interest you?”).
Order options logically: by frequency, alphabetically, or in a natural sequence.

guidelines.do: Use a CheckboxGroup with a legend for related options.
guidelines.dont: Stack loose checkboxes under a paragraph.
guidelines.why: The legend is announced with each option, so people know what they’re choosing.

guidelines.do: Use a Switch for settings that apply at once.
guidelines.dont: Save a checkbox immediately when it’s clicked.
guidelines.why: People expect checkboxes to wait for Submit.

guidelines.do: Make the label clickable (it is by default).
guidelines.dont: Put the label in a separate element that doesn’t toggle.
guidelines.why: The label is a much larger, easier target than the box.

accessibility.role: checkbox (native input); group is a fieldset with a legend.

aria.when: Implied by the native indeterminate property.
Description and error of a single checkbox.
A single checkbox with an error.

wcag.how: Box borders meet 3:1 in every theme.
The label extends the click target.
Checked and mixed states come from the native input.

examples.title: Single checkbox
examples.description: A yes/no in a form, with an error.
examples.code:
import { Checkbox } from '@ds/react';

<Checkbox
  name="terms"
  label="I accept the terms and conditions"
  error={errors.terms && 'Accept the terms to continue.'}
  required
/>

examples.title: Group
examples.code:
import { CheckboxGroup, Checkbox } from '@ds/react';

<CheckboxGroup label="Topics" name="topics" defaultValue={['design']}>
  <Checkbox value="design" label="Design" />
  <Checkbox value="engineering" label="Engineering" />
  <Checkbox value="research" label="Research" description="Studies and interviews" />
</CheckboxGroup>

examples.title: Select all
examples.description: Indeterminate while some rows are selected.

related.relation: When exactly one option must be chosen.
Provides the group’s legend and messages.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description:
A box people tick to turn one option on or off, or to pick several options from a list.
The change applies when the form is submitted; for immediate effect, use a Switch.

label.description: Visible label; clicking it toggles the box. Without it, pass aria-label.

error.description: Error for a single checkbox, e.g. “Accept the terms to continue”. Marks it invalid.

onCheckedChange.description: Called with the new checked state.

indeterminate.description: Shows a dash for “some but not all”, e.g. a select-all box. Announced as “mixed”.

size.description: `small` for dense lists, `medium` by default, `large` for touch-first forms.

value.description: Value submitted with the form, and the id of this option inside a CheckboxGroup.

components.name: CheckboxGroup
components.description:
A set of checkboxes answering one question, e.g. “Which topics interest you?”. A fieldset
with a legend, help text and one error for the whole group.

onValueChange.description: Called with the new list of checked values.

orientation.description: `vertical` (default) stacks options; `horizontal` puts short options in a row.

size.description: Size of every checkbox in the group.

name.description: Form field name shared by the checkboxes.

children.description: The Checkbox options, each with a value.

disabled.description: Disables the control (and every control in a group).

required.description: Marks the field required: an asterisk after the label and `required` on the control.

id.description: Id of the control. Generated when not given.

label.description: What the control is for, e.g. "Message". Always required: it names the control.

description.description: Help text, e.g. a format hint. Announced with the control.

error.description: Error message. Marks the control invalid and replaces the success message.

hideLabel.description: Hides the label visually but keeps it for screen readers. Only when context makes it obvious.

optional.description: Marks the field optional with text after the label. Use when most fields are required.

optionalLabel.description: Text shown for optional fields. Default "(optional)".

--checkbox-icon-color.description: Text and icons on the matching --color-bg-accent fill.

--checkbox-error-border-color.description: Solid fill for emphasized actions of a tone, e.g. filled buttons.

--checkbox-label-font-family.description: Body text and most UI text.

--checkbox-description-text-color.description: Supporting text on surfaces: descriptions, metadata, placeholders.

--checkbox-error-text-color.description: Tone-colored text directly on surfaces, e.g. text buttons and links.

--checkbox-group-horizontal-gap.description: Gap between groups inside a section.

--checkbox-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring.

--checkbox-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between an element and its focus ring.
